responsibility: This file implements serialization helpers for GCC's generic LTO/streamer layer. It manages growth of lto_output_stream block chains, interns strings into the shared string table and emits indices, writes variable-length signed and unsigned integers, poly_int values, gcov counters, raw byte blocks, and wide_int/widest_int representations, and provides bitpack-aware string emission. It is the low-level output side of GCC's typed bytecode streaming support.
